summary: Frontend-only re-test of iteration_4 fixes: mobile header overflow (390x844) and Invalid DOM property 'fetchpriority' console warning. Both fixes VERIFIED. Regression checks (desktop calc + shared footer + canada page) also pass.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1005 lines — consider splitting the homepage/calculator/FAQ/footer sections into smaller components for maintainability (non-blocking).

Radix DropdownMenu items rendered in portal cause Playwright pointer-event interception ('html intercepts pointer events'). Not a real-user bug (native browser clicks work; href navigation is correct), but a testing hint: end-to-end tests should navigate via URL rather than clicking dropdown links, OR replace the Radix menu items with native anchors if E2E click testing on them is required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_5 confirmed: (1) Mobile 390x844 header no longer overflows: scrollWidth=390, clientWidth=390 (was 408 vs 390). Country nav trigger renders as globe+chevron only (no label) on mobile, remains visible (bbox x=306 w=68, well within 390px), and dropdown opens on tap showing all 5 countries. (2) No 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority' warnings in console (hero img uses camelCase fetchPriority). (3) Desktop 1920x800 calculator: Standard (default 'standard' benefit type) + 1960-04-15 -> 'Wednesday, July 15, 2026' as expected. Desktop trigger shows full 'Payment Date Checkers' text. (4) Canada page loads at /canada/cpp-payment-dates/ (title: 'Canada CPP Payment Dates 2026 | CheckPayDate.com'); data-testid=country-nav-canada anchor has correct href='/canada/cpp-payment-dates/'; dropdown opens on both mobile and desktop showing Canada option. Site-footer (data-testid=site-footer) visible on both homepage and canada page. NOTE: dob input testid is 'calculator-birth-date-input' (not 'calculator-dob-input'); benefit select testid is 'calculator-benefit-type-select' (id='benefit-type'). Playwright cannot click through Radix DropdownMenu portal (html intercepts pointer events) — dropdown link navigation is verified by href attribute + direct URL load, not by simulated click.
